details.description: Claude Opus 4 (claude-opus-4-20250514) is Anthropic's flagship model at its May 22, 2025 release, built for sustained, complex work such as long-running coding and agentic tasks. It combines a near-instant response mode with an extended-thinking mode for deeper reasoning, and accepts both text and image input. Anthropic released it under its AI Safety Level 3 (ASL-3) standard. By September 2026 Anthropic lists claude-opus-4-20250514 as Retired on both the Claude API and Amazon Bedrock, recommending Claude Opus 4.8 as the replacement.
advantages: Sustains focus on long-running, multi-step agentic tasks for several hours without degrading, per Anthropic's Claude 4 launch post.
65% less likely than Claude Sonnet 3.7 to take shortcuts or exploit loopholes when completing tasks, per Anthropic's launch post.
Supports an extended-thinking mode that can use tools, including web search, during its reasoning process, per Anthropic's launch post.
Dramatically outperforms prior Claude models on memory tasks when given local file access, creating and maintaining its own memory files, per Anthropic's launch post.
disadvantages: Retired: Anthropic's model-deprecations page lists claude-opus-4-20250514 as Retired (deprecated April 14, 2026, retired June 15, 2026 on the Claude API), and the Amazon Bedrock legacy model table also marks it Retired, both recommending claude-opus-4-8 as the replacement.
use_cases: Software engineering: feature implementation, debugging, and refactoring in large codebases
Long-running autonomous agent workflows spanning many tool calls and several hours
Graduate-level reasoning and research tasks using extended thinking
Maintaining task memory across long sessions via local file access, when given file-system tools

sources.title: Claude on Amazon Bedrock (Opus 4.6 and earlier) - Claude Platform Docs

notes: Catalog's facts have no deprecation_date for claude-opus-4, but Anthropic's own docs mark claude-opus-4-20250514 Retired on both the Claude API (retired June 15, 2026) and the Amazon Bedrock legacy model table; a dedicated AWS Bedrock model-card page for it no longer exists (confirmed by direct fetch returning no content), consistent with retirement. The full Claude 4 system-card PDF could not be fetched directly (redirected to a PDF this tool couldn't open); benchmark figures and capability claims are from Anthropic's Claude 4 launch post instead.
